name: Data Analyzer: AI request tells the service not to store the conversation by default
objective: Proves that by default the request sent to the AI service asks it not to keep a copy of the data.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Extract fields from the made-up text 'age: integer' with no store setting configured
steps.expected: The request body sent contains 'store' set to false

name: Data Analyzer: AI request can omit the store option with one setting
objective: Proves that setting LLM_RESPONSES_STORE to 'omit' removes the store option from the request, for services that reject it.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Set the setting to 'omit' and extract fields from 'age: integer'
steps.expected: The request body sent has no 'store' entry at all

name: Data Analyzer: AI request is sent with redirect-following turned off
objective: Proves the credential-bearing request to the AI service cannot be silently forwarded to another address.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Extract fields from 'age: integer' and inspect how the request was sent
steps.expected: The request was made with the 'allow redirects' option set to false

name: Data Analyzer: A redirect answer from the AI service is treated as a failure
objective: Proves that if the AI service replies with HTTP 302 (a redirect), the program stops with a clear error instead of following it.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Make the canned service reply with status 302 and run the extraction
steps.expected: An error is raised with the error class 'redirect_refused'; exactly one request was made (no retry, no follow-up)

name: Data Analyzer: Unencrypted http address for the AI service is rejected at startup
objective: Proves the AI client refuses to be set up with a non-encrypted web address.
precondition: No network. The environment is set with an http:// (not https://) endpoint and no insecure override.

steps.expected: A ValueError (a configuration error) is raised

name: Data Analyzer: Unencrypted address is allowed only with an explicit local-development switch
objective: Proves a plain http address works only when the developer deliberately sets the override, e.g. for a local test model.
precondition: No network. Endpoint set to a local http address and LLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_ENDPOINT set to 1.

steps.data: Endpoint http://localhost:9999/ with the override on
steps.expected: Creation succeeds and the stored endpoint still starts with 'http://'

name: Data Analyzer: Switching to an http address after startup is still blocked when a request is made
objective: Proves the https check is repeated at the moment of each call, so changing the address later cannot bypass it.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Create the client with a valid https endpoint, then change its endpoint to an http address, then try an extraction
steps.expected: An error is raised with class 'endpoint_not_https' and the web request function was never called

name: Data Analyzer: Oversized data dictionary is rejected before anything is sent to the AI
objective: Proves a data dictionary over the character limit is refused with a clear error and costs nothing.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Set the input limit to 1000 characters and parse a text of 1001 'x' characters
steps.expected: An error with class 'input_too_large' is raised and no request was sent to the AI

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary needing too many pieces is refused, not silently cut short
objective: Proves a large dictionary that would need more AI calls than the limit is rejected outright rather than partly processed.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured. The token counter and splitter are replaced so the text appears long and splits into 3 pieces.

steps.action: Set the chunk limit to 2 and parse text that splits into 3 pieces
steps.expected: An error with class 'too_many_chunks' is raised and no request was sent to the AI

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary needing exactly the maximum number of pieces is still processed
objective: Proves the limit is not off by one: text splitting into exactly the allowed number of pieces is handled in full.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured. The token counter and splitter are replaced so the text splits into 2 pieces.

steps.action: Set the chunk limit to 2 and parse text that splits into 2 pieces
steps.expected: The result reports 2 chunks processed and exactly 2 requests were sent

name: Data Analyzer: AI request always allows at least 40,000 output tokens
objective: Proves the output allowance for the AI answer is not set too low, which would cut off or empty the answers of reasoning models.
precondition: No network and no AI model: the web request to the Azure OpenAI service is replaced by a canned answer, with a made-up endpoint address and deployment name configured.

steps.action: Extract fields from 'age: integer' and inspect the request
steps.expected: The maximum-output-tokens value in the request is 40000 or more
